data.name: Kamruddin
data.gender_notes: Kamruddin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamruddin is a compound name derived from the Arabic and Persian languages. 'Kamru' means 'beautiful garden', and 'din' means 'lord'. Thus, Kamruddin translates to 'Lord of the beautiful garden'. This name is often used for boys in Hindu communities, particularly in India. The name Kamruddin carries the meaning “Lord of the beautiful garden” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic, Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamruddin usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the beautiful garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with beauty and prosperity.
data.etymology: Kamruddin belongs to the Arabic, Persian linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the beautiful garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamruddin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
